mapper.update: UPDATE tbl_transaction SET merchant_name = #{merchantName}, merchant_name_normalized = #{merchantNameNormalized}, amount = #{amount}, direction = #{direction}, tr_date = #{trDate}, tr_time = #{trTime}, description1 = #{description1}, classification = #{classification}, source_type = #{sourceType}, correlation_id = #{correlationId}, original_approval_no = #{originalApprovalNo}, merchant_category_code = #{merchantCategoryCode}, merchant_category_name = #{merchantCategoryName}, raw_json = #{rawJson} WHERE codef_tr_key = #{codefTrKey}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tbl_transaction (user_id, account_id, codef_tr_key, merchant_name, merchant_name_normalized, amount, direction, tr_date, tr_time, description1, classification, category_id, is_excluded_from_summary, loan_id, source_type, card_id, correlation_id, original_approval_no, merchant_category_code, merchant_category_name, raw_json) VALUES (#{userId}, #{accountId}, #{codefTrKey}, #{merchantName}, #{merchantNameNormalized}, #{amount}, #{direction}, #{trDate}, #{trTime}, #{description1}, #{classification}, #{categoryId}, #{isExcludedFromSummary}, #{loanId}, #{sourceType}, #{cardId}, #{correlationId}, #{originalApprovalNo}, #{merchantCategoryCode}, #{merchantCategoryName}, #{rawJson})
mapper.update: UPDATE tbl_transaction bank JOIN tbl_transaction card ON card.user_id = bank.user_id AND card.correlation_id = bank.correlation_id AND card.source_type = 'CARD_CHECK' SET bank.linked_transaction_id = card.id, bank.is_excluded_from_summary = 1, card.linked_transaction_id = bank.id WHERE bank.user_id = #{userId} AND bank.source_type = 'BANK' AND bank.correlation_id IS NOT NULL AND bank.linked_transaction_id IS NULL AND card.linked_transaction_id IS NULL
